units.source_text: 薰大将站着窥看，渐渐腰痛起来。

en.t: General Kaoru stood peering in, and little by little his lower back began to ache.

units.source_text: 但是，为欲使那边不觉得此地有人，还是一动不动地站着。

en.t: However, so that those on the other side would not sense anyone was there, he kept standing perfectly still.

units.source_text: 但见那青年侍女吃惊地说：“好香啊！

en.t: Then he saw the young maid say in surprise, "What a lovely fragrance!

units.source_text: 这种香气太美妙了！

en.t: This scent is truly wonderful!

units.source_text: 大约是那老尼姑在薰香吧。”

en.t: Perhaps that old nun is burning incense."

units.source_text: 那老侍女说：“的确，这种香气真好闻啊！

en.t: The older maid said, "Indeed, this fragrance smells truly lovely!

units.source_text: 京里的人到底风雅时髦。

en.t: People from the capital really are elegant and refined.

units.source_text: 我们夫人在这方面算是天下闻名的能手，

en.t: Our lady is known throughout the world as a master in this art,

units.source_text: 但在东国调制不出这种香料。

en.t: but in the eastern provinces one cannot blend incense like this.

units.source_text: 这里的老尼姑生活虽然极其简朴，

en.t: Although the old nun here lives in extreme simplicity,

units.source_text: 服装倒很讲究，

en.t: she is quite particular about her clothing,

units.source_text: 尽管是灰色的、青色的，

en.t: even if the colors are gray or blue,

units.source_text: 样子也很漂亮呢。”

en.t: and she still looks very beautiful."

units.source_text: 她如此称赞弁君。

en.t: In this way she praised Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 此时那边廊下走进一个女童来，

en.t: Just then, a little girl came in from the veranda on that side,

units.source_text: 说道：“请吃些茶点。”

en.t: and said, "Please have some refreshments."

units.source_text: 便接连地送过几盘食物来。

en.t: Then several plates of food were brought in one after another.

units.source_text: 侍女把果物送到小姐身边，

en.t: The maid brought fruit to the young lady's side,

units.source_text: 叫她起来：“请小姐吃些果物吧。”

en.t: and urged her to get up: "Please have some fruit, my lady."

units.source_text: 但小姐不起来吃。

en.t: But the young lady did not get up to eat.

units.source_text: 两个侍女就拿些果物，

en.t: The two maids then took some fruit,

units.source_text: 大约是栗子吧，

en.t: probably chestnuts,

units.source_text: 喀啦喀啦地嚼着吃。

en.t: and ate them, crunching noisily.

units.source_text: 薰大将听不惯这种声音，颇感不快，

en.t: General Kaoru, unaccustomed to that sound, found it rather unpleasant,

units.source_text: 便离开洞隙，退后几步。

en.t: so he moved away from the gap and stepped back a few paces.

units.source_text: 但一离开就想念那人，

en.t: But as soon as he left, he longed for her,

units.source_text: 立刻又走过去窥看。

en.t: and immediately went back to peer in again.

units.source_text: 比这女子身份高贵的人，自明石皇后开始，

en.t: Women of higher rank than this one, beginning with Empress Akashi,

units.source_text: 相貌漂亮的、人品温良的，他至今见过很多。

en.t: women beautiful in appearance and gentle in character, he had seen many of them before.

units.source_text: 除非十分优越的，总不能牵惹他的心目。

en.t: Unless someone was exceptionally superior, she could never draw his heart or eye.

units.source_text: 所以别人都批评他过分老实。

en.t: For that reason, others all criticized him as being overly earnest.

units.source_text: 然而只有此次，这女子并无何等特别优美之处，

en.t: Yet this time alone, although this woman had no especially outstanding beauty,

units.source_text: 他却贪看得不肯离去，

en.t: he kept gazing at her greedily and would not leave,

units.source_text: 真是一种怪僻的心理。

en.t: which was truly a strange and eccentric state of mind.
